bottleneck_evidence: Previous source817 PMU D126half VEC39.169/MTE236.415/MTE336.514us; D254float VEC52.964/MTE277.146/MTE361.128us, all48core means, replaydiagnosis only.

expected_metrics.direct: remove3 half input DataCopy and2 half output DataCopy per job in FP32; retain c/s expansion and6 arithmetic APIs
expected_metrics.compact: reuse measured FP16 reduction; no new FP32 broadcast
expected_metrics.pipeline: unchanged GM traffic/instructions and arithmetic; overlap independent MTE2/V/MTE3, reduce elapsed critical path, no claim busy ratio is lane utilization

queue_dependency.input: GM->UB EnQue sets MTE2_V; DeQue waits. FreeTensor sets V_MTE2; AllocTensor on reused slot waits until all input V reads complete.
queue_dependency.output: V writes/copy -> EnQue V_MTE3 -> DeQue wait -> DataCopyPad. FreeTensor sets MTE3_V; subsequent AllocTensor waits before vector writes/trig scratch.
queue_dependency.p0: Copy both valid padded half arrays from input to output via VEC, then normal VECOUT EnQue/DeQue and stores; input is never used directly as MTE3 source.
queue_dependency.scratch: FP32 c/s/tmp persist in3cap work; angle is output[0:pitch], temp output[cap:cap+pitch], q tmp[0:pitch], only before rotation output writes. FP16 a/b/trig scratch before inputs loaded, then a/b retained while lo/hi/tmp used.
queue_dependency.prefetch: Prefetch(begin) only when begin<end; after DeQue current, prefetch job+1 only if job+1<end. Max2 live input slots, no unconsumed last prefetch. Output slots max2; final PIPE_ALL drains.

frequency_scratch_caveat: FP32 work shrinks5cap to3cap. FillDeviceFrequencies function/math unchanged, but scratch-derived vector chunk/fallback can differ for small heads. Large target cap4096 still uses full pitch in either layout. Explicitly verify outputs across all1625; do not claim initialization cost unchanged in smaller families.
dtype_shape_family: Existing generic Rotary nonaligned FP16/FP32 only; original Host dispatch/tiling unchanged; int32 positions
hypothesis: Remove redundant FP32 queue-to-work copies, retain measured FP16 compact coefficients, then overlap unchanged strided MTE2/VEC/MTE3 work through depth2 queues and next-job prefetch.

changes.direct: FP32 original dense c/s, queue-direct4Mul/Sub/Add, depths1 and per-job drain
changes.compact: Only FP16 reuses compact coefficients/input retention, depths1 and drain; FP32 direct entries unchanged
changes.pipeline: Both use depth2 and next-job prefetch; p0 copies via output queue; per-job PIPE_ALL removed, one final drain

prior_attempts_reviewed: Previous d655 mixed broadcast: FP16 benefit, FP32 6.07% regression; no broad promotion, old response unchanged
Q53 tail pruning0.995493x; trueFMA residual unsupported; accumulation folding no robust gain; no retries
Broad Gather, bankpadding, positions UB cache, masks, wide two-read and trig polynomial precision negatives remain preserved
